query:
SELECT count(*) AS "n!" FROM (
                                   SELECT FROM svs.attributions a
                                   JOIN svs.runs r ON r.id = a.run_id
                                   WHERE svs.run_matches(r, $1)
                                     AND ($2::timestamptz IS NULL OR a.updated_at >= $2)
                                     AND a.updated_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $3)
                                   LIMIT $4) x
